blocks.content: Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data
Imagine if each part of the app could just get what it needs directly. No passing things down. No one component responsible for everything.
App does one thing: puts the pieces together. Each feature reaches for its own data independently.
Same app. Same features. Just without the pile-up.
Instead of one component owning the state and passing it everywhere, what if the state lived outside all components? In one central place that any component can access directly?
No prop drilling. No lifting state. Each component just connects to the store and takes exactly what it needs.
Next, you will meet the tool you will use to build it. Click Next Lesson to continue.
